converters.name: mef2_to_nwb
converters.description: A MEF 2.0 recording is a folder of one .mef file per channel. Pass the package id of each channel file the plot needs (one for a single channel, two for a montage), or the folder's id together with the channel names in template_args.channel / channel2 and plot_file picks the files. A folder without channel names is refused, since that would convert every channel.
